subject.title: [Bug]: sessions_yield subagent wake can compact parent branch at low context usage

question: Should this issue require both a runtime overflow-decision fix and a persisted compaction trigger field before it can close, or should trigger metadata be split into a separate follow-up?
rationale: The central bug is runtime correctness, but the requested trigger metadata changes the persisted transcript shape and affects future diagnostics; automation should not choose that product/schema boundary alone.

options.title: Fix Both In This Item
options.body: Keep this issue open until the low-context compaction trigger is fixed and compaction entries carry a typed cause such as overflow, threshold, manual, or sessions-yield wake.

options.title: Split Metadata Follow-up
options.body: Treat the premature compaction as this issue's required fix and move persisted trigger metadata to a narrower diagnostics issue.

options.title: Wait For Live Repro
options.body: Pause implementation until a maintainer or QA lane can reproduce the yielded-parent wake path on current main with full runtime logs.

recommendation.title: Fix Both In This Item
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until the low-context compaction trigger is fixed and compaction entries carry a typed cause such as overflow, threshold, manual, or sessions-yield wake.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent context-engine and preflight overflow budgeting work makes this the best available owner for the compaction-policy decision, with LZY3538 and steipete as code-history backups.
